opening.argument: Paid education packages are presented as the route to tokens that can produce cryptocurrency and put money back in buyers’ pockets. The speaker urges immediate purchase to start mining and participate in growth, while warning that more tokens will be required over time to produce one coin, leaving fewer coins per package. The pitch adds projected gains of up to 55 to 110 times the coin’s value and a free-gold promotion tied to buying before a deadline. Although the growth figures are predictions, the presentation links package payments to substantial potential returns and presses viewers to act before the terms change. That combination supports the conclusion that this is a token-purchase scheme promoted through promised appreciation or returns, not merely education.
